rules.name: orenda-ready-queue
rules.description: Usage instance (:2137) agent queue: fires while GET /api/v1/agent/tasks?ready=true returns count > 0. Requires ORENDA_AGENT_TOKEN in the environment (falls back to the token in ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json mcp.orenda args; optionally ORENDA_URL). Broadcast: every open session gets the prompt; double-claim is rejected by the server (409 lock_taken).
